// B732: what the yaml package (editDoc, as limits.mjs) writes for strings
// with a \uD800-\uDFFF escape. YAML_JS=<node_modules/yaml/dist/index.js>
// node gen_b732.mjs.txt > b732.json (run as .mjs). value is the JSON text of the value.
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
const { parseDocument } = await import(pathToFileURL(process.env.YAML_JS).href);
function edit(text, segs, change) {
  const doc = parseDocument(text, { prettyErrors: false });
  const js = doc.errors.length === 0 ? doc.toJS() : null;
  if (js === null || typeof js !== 'object' || Array.isArray(js)) return { error: 'parse' };
  try {
    if ('set' in change) doc.setIn(segs, doc.createNode(change.set));
    else doc.deleteIn(segs);
  } catch { return { error: 'throw' }; }
  try { return { out: String(doc) }; } catch { return { error: 'stringify' }; }
}
const cases = [];
function add(name, text, key, op, json) {
  const segs = key.split('.');
  const c = { name, text, segs, op };
  if (op === 'set') Object.assign(c, { value: json }, edit(text, segs, { set: JSON.parse(json) }));
  else Object.assign(c, edit(text, segs, { remove: true }));
  cases.push(c);
}
const BASE = 'version: 1\nproject:\n  slug: s # keep\n';
add('high', BASE, 'project.name', 'set', '"x\\ud800y"');
add('low upper', BASE, 'project.name', 'set', '"\\uDC00"');
add('quote and backslash', BASE, 'project.name', 'set', '"a\\"\\ud800\\\\"');
add('two lone', BASE, 'project.name', 'set', '"\\udc00\\ud800"');
add('high then text then low', BASE, 'project.name', 'set', '"\\ud800-\\udc00"');
add('looks plain', BASE, 'project.name', 'set', '"- \\ud800: #x"');
add('long', BASE, 'project.name', 'set', JSON.stringify('w '.repeat(30)).slice(0, -1) + '\\ud800"');
add('very long', BASE, 'project.name', 'set', JSON.stringify('w '.repeat(40)).slice(0, -1) + '\\ud800"');
add('in a list', BASE, 'review.exclude', 'set', '["\\udbff","ok"]');
add('in a map', BASE, 'project.meta', 'set', '{"a":"\\ud800","b":1}');
const HAS = 'version: 1\nproject:\n  name: "x\\ud800y" # c\n  slug: s\n';
add('read and replace', HAS, 'project.name', 'set', '"plain"');
add('read and remove', HAS, 'project.name', 'remove');
add('read and set sibling', HAS, 'project.slug', 'set', '"t"');
add('read escaped quote', 'version: 1\nproject:\n  name: "a\\"\\ud800\\\\"\n', 'project.slug', 'set', '"t"');
add('read in a list', 'version: 1\nreview:\n  exclude:\n    - "\\udbff"\n    - ok\n', 'project.slug', 'set', '"t"');
add('read pair escape', 'version: 1\nproject:\n  name: "\\ud83d\\ude00"\n', 'project.slug', 'set', '"t"');
add('read upper escape', 'version: 1\nproject:\n  name: "\\uD800"\n', 'project.slug', 'set', '"t"');
add('read other escape', 'version: 1\nproject:\n  name: "\\ud800\\n"\n', 'project.slug', 'set', '"t"');
process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(cases, null, 2) + '\n');
